goal:
在酿酒酵母 S288C 中，哪些已发表的观察支持蛋白参与海藻糖的水解？数据库注释、纯化酶的底物实验和细胞内表型各能支持多强的判断？给研究者一页中文证据评述。

请自行拟定检索式、选择数据库记录和原文。让文献与数据库调查并行，必要时调整检索；在看读数前说明如何判断物种、底物和反应方向匹配，怎样处理反例、间接证据和未覆盖记录。保留有位置的原文和具名数据库记录，从中选择下一项调查。只研究已经公开的天然蛋白和实验观察。

final_decision.rationale: 已核对 S288C 的三份 Swiss-Prot 原始记录及文献实验的材料、底物和读数。Nth1 和 Ath1 的分子功能注释列有直接测定，Nth2 列的是突变体表型。Plank 等把纯化重组 Nth1、海藻糖和随时间生成的葡萄糖对应到同一实验，编码供体未注明。Kienle 等与 Alizadeh 和 Klionsky 的作者摘要分别提供纯化酸性酶的水解对照及其与 ATH1 的蛋白鉴定。Chen 等在同背景对照中发现胞内储糖依次为亲本、nth2Δ、nth1Δ、双缺失株递增，定量时外加了商品海藻糖酶。ath1Δ 失去了利用外源海藻糖生长的能力，其稳定期储糖效应在葡萄酒株 CSM 中亦有例外。Deng 等的纯化 Ima 制剂保有异麦芽糖活性，对海藻糖的未检出只适用于原条件。根据前一轮选定的原文，Schepers 等在营养刺激后测到粗提液总酶活，BY4742 衍生宿主中对 Nth1 的免疫检测读出为磷酸化和蛋白结合，无法据此把总水解活性分配给该株的 Nth1。文献和数据库的并行调查已提供评述所需的证据层次，并已查到 Nth2 的相反结果。

decisions.rationale: 先并行检索通用酶学、酸性海藻糖酶和中性海藻糖酶。预设判据为原文可核对物种、菌株或蛋白来源、制备、底物身份和反应方向。以纯化天然序列蛋白测得葡萄糖生成或海藻糖消耗作为直接生化证据。把只写 trehalose 的底物注明原文命名，核对对照、其他底物及检测条件。分别记录细胞或裂解液观察、标签及序列修饰、其他或未交代的菌株和全文缺口。
首轮 Europe PMC 与 Crossref 均有命中。宽检的开放结果多为其他物种，Crossref 列出的经典纯化论文需要以题名或 DOI 复核可取得性。先限定酿酒酵母或作者、酶名与题名以寻找带葡萄糖产物读数的原文，同时以酵母异麦芽糖酶的底物筛查寻找直接的阴性对照。证据按原始材料的酿酒酵母菌株与谱系、天然序列和蛋白制备、游离 α,α-海藻糖、消耗底物或生成葡萄糖以及反应条件判断。

Both Europe PMC and Crossref returned hits for the six searches. Exact-title/DOI follow-ups identify the purified yeast ATH1 paper (PMID 8764988), the 1976 acid trehalase assay and the Nth1 structural series, but none has a fetchable record in those narrowed candidate pages. The parallel specificity search identified an open primary S. cerevisiae isomaltase panel, PMC3953731. Acquire it and broaden the two trehalase searches to open primary literature that quantifies substrates in vitro or in cells. Before interpreting results, require named S. cerevisiae protein and source strain/pedigree, wild-type sequence distinguished from alterations, the assayed starting sugar/linkage, and direction supported by measured product or substrate loss attributable to hydrolysis. Preserve inactive conditions, any positive control and assay sensitivity. Binding, protein abundance, growth and cellular trehalose mobilization support narrower conclusions than purified turnover. Unavailable originals remain bibliographic leads.

Deng et al., PMC3953731 Table 2 (t0010, p238–243 and p270–275, footnote p352) gives a direct substrate-matched negative for purified tagged Ima1/2/3/5, with positive isomaltose controls. The methods identify CEN.PK113-5D as expression host and glucose-coupled readout. The acid and neutral targeted bibliographic searches found key older papers with no granted fetchable JATS, including Kienle 1993, Alizadeh 1996, Jules 2008 and Alblova 2017. Two open yeast studies can resolve native-protein versus cellular attribution. A bounded source-citation search follows the early acid preparation and seeks a directly measured positive reaction. Two submissions remain for the best result or a targeted alternative.

Dengler et al. used purified Nth1 in phosphorylation assays and W303-derived cells to measure stored trehalose. Their bibliography identifies the App and Holzer purification of neutral trehalase from ABYS1 and specific cell-cycle studies. The earlier acid-trehalase searches retrieved informative primary abstracts from Kienle, Mittenbühler, and Alizadeh without a fetchable JATS article. One focused search allows a final acquisition for a direct reaction or an explicitly characterized extract assay. Existing open fallback PMC3531729 is indexed in gxa_01m8dar2dtb2ayrn1c.

The targeted Europe PMC query recovered the ABYS1 neutral-enzyme purification (App and Holzer, PMID 2507544), the Panni et al. purified system (PMID 17916074), and two 2016 CDK articles, all without an admitted fetchable PMCID in this return. The open Plank et al. article (PMC7124472) matched the purified/recombinant Nth1 and glucose-release or activity-assay terms and explicitly studies Nth1 activation. Use the remaining acquisition on its original Methods and Results to identify which preparation produced each readout. This comparison can add molecular evidence alongside the S288C-derivative phenotypes in PMC11540316, W303-derived cellular evidence in PMC7806596, and linkage-specific negative results for the active Ima preparations in PMC3953731.

post_read_actions.rationale: NTH2 定向检索带来一条新增线索。Tan 等在作者摘要中把面包酵母缺失 NTH1 和/或 ATH1 时的胞内海藻糖降解与 NTH2 联系起来。该记录与 Jules 等一样缺少本索引可调取的正文，无法把具体基因型、酶制剂和葡萄糖读数对应起来。Nwaka 等则报告破坏 YBR0106 后未见总活性和储量变化。可取的转运研究使用大肠杆菌 TreA 测糖，不能回答酿酒酵母 Nth2 的催化归属。Chen 等的原文支持 S288C 衍生株的储糖顺序，测糖所用的水解酶由研究者在取样后加入。结束已达到停止条件的 NTH2 检索，保留纯化 Nth2 的证据缺口。下一项判读使用已在调取的 PMC3531729，核对野生型 Nth1 的菌株、制剂、加底物后的产物和对照，以判断其结果能否落实到 S288C 谱系。
